answer.reason: Several verses say what happened at Kadeshbarnea: spies were sent from it and Israel rebelled there; the rest are boundary or distance notes.

clauses.english: was where Moses sent men to see the land
clauses.quote: when I sent them from Kadeshbarnea to see the land

clauses.english: was where Israel rebelled against the command to go up and possess the land
clauses.quote: ye rebelled against the commandment of the LORD your God

doubts: Verses giving it as a border point (NUM 34:4, JOS 15:3), a distance (DEU 1:2) or a limit of Joshua's conquest (JOS 10:41) were not used as events.
